heading: HDD/SSD Enclosure
bottomHtml:
HDD/SSD Enclosure – External Hard Drive Case for Safe & Convenient Storage

Turn your internal hard drive into an external storage device with our high-quality HDD Enclosure. Designed for 2.5” and 3.5” SATA hard drives, this enclosure provides a secure and portable solution for backup storage, file transfers, and data management. Keep your data safe while enhancing the portability and usability of your hard drives.

Key Features:

  • Wide Compatibility: Supports 2.5” and 3.5” SATA I/II/III hard drives.

  • Fast Data Transfer: USB 3.0 interface for speeds up to 5Gbps, backward compatible with USB 2.0.

  • Durable & Protective: Sturdy casing with shock-resistant design to safeguard your drive.

  • Plug & Play: Easy setup, no additional drivers required, compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux.

  • Tool-Free Installation: Simple, quick assembly with no need for screws.

  • Compact & Portable: Sleek, lightweight design for easy transport and storage.

Perfect for expanding your storage, safely backing up files, or repurposing old hard drives, this HDD Enclosure offers reliable performance and ease of use. Available now at D CORE with fast delivery throughout Bangladesh.
